That would also work but has slightly different behavior on timeout. My version rejects with the `TypeError` thrown by `read()` when `releaseLock()` is called while yours will resolve with `undefined`. Either is fine as long as the caller expects the right behavior.

I think the only motivation for one over the other is that your version allocates more promises and doesn't cancel the timer when it is no longer necessary. That said, my version doesn't cancel the timer if `read()` rejects for a different reason.

Which version do you think is easier for developers to understand?
